notes.title: Fall Festival Lost Demo
notes.content:
[h1]Get a Taste of Lost[/h1]

A new demo is being released for Lost, an atmospheric and emotional precision platformer! Test out the game's unique mechanic of darkening the world around you when you move, forcing the player to think ahead and react quickly to the hostile environment. This demo includes 9 levels, 3 from each of the first 3 worlds in the game. You can also try out the challenge mode which forces you to beat each level in record time, a fun challenge for those who take to the game easily or for speedrunners wanting to test their skills! If you enjoy the demo please wishlist the game so you can get it when it releases on October 13th! 

If you have any questions or comments about the demo you can email me at lostgamedeveloper@gmail.com and I'll be happy to help with any issues you run into or questions you have!
